name: yalesites-product
description: Product team workflows for YaleSites: guided first-time setup of a Mac or Windows computer for the ticket workflow, release prep, ticket creation and grooming, PR feedback scoped to what the reviewer actually reviews, drafting web content for yalesites.yale.edu and reviewing batches of docs changes side by side with the live page before they are built, keeping tickets in sync with how work actually turns out, UX research context for product decisions, Beacon AI chatbot test question sets and comparison analysis, and read-only migration assessment of a source site against the YaleSites content model.
